prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter,deque
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # connected components of non-bg cells
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]!=bg:
                            seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(comp)

    if not comps: return g
    obj=comps[0]
    if len(obj)<2: return g
    rs=[a for a,b in obj]; cs=[b for a,b in obj]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    tpl=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
